item.title: Medical record imports save results from more patient portals
item.summary: Lab results, notes, and vitals now import from portals whose records use long identifiers or leave out a last-updated time.
item.details: Records without a last-updated time are ordered by when Murph retrieved them, so a newer import replaces an older one and repeating the same import changes nothing. If an earlier import saved only source evidence, reconnect the portal to save its results.
